contentSummary: The contact page carries almost no editorial copy — it is a bare two-part utility page. Part one is a 50/50 row: a Google Maps embed centred on Alang, Gujarat on the left, and a "Send Message" enquiry form (first name, last name, email, country-code + phone, message) on the right. Part two is a "Head Office" card listing exactly five facts: contact person Mr. Devang Gujarati, mobile +91 9925499123, phone +91 278 2429573, email info@sachdevagroup.in, and website www.sachdevagroup.in. There is no H1, no intro paragraph, no street address in the Head Office card itself, no office hours, no per-department routing, and no B2B-specific enquiry fields (company, vessel name/IMO, LDT, flag state,…

blocks.summary: Empty page banner. Markup is literally <section class="page-title6 theme-before"></section> with zero children — no H1, no subtitle, no breadcrumb. CSS gives it a 400px min-height, 220px top padding, a fixed-attachment photo (images/about/about-head-bg6.jpg) and a navy-to-teal 70% gradient overlay at z-index 11. It renders as a blank 400px colour wash. The page has no H1 anywhere as a result.

Decorative background flourish inside .section-contact: a wrapping a single with no and no alt. Positioned absolute right:0 / top:-40px, height 300px, rotated 290deg. Purely ornamental; overflows the section box on narrow viewports because .section-contact has no CSS rule at all (no overflow:hidden).

Left half (col-md-6) of the contact row: a Google Maps iframe embed centred on Alang, Gujarat (the recycling yard), width 100%, hardcoded height 600, frameborder 0, inline style="border: 0", allowfullscreen, aria-hidden="false", tabindex="0". The pb= parameter is a frozen 2020-vintage embed string (4v1599382468743). No title attribute, no lazy loading, no rounded frame, no overlay card, no 'Get directions' action.
